title: Linear velocity expression
description: Essential: The student must provide the correct formula for the Moon's orbital speed, v = 2πr / T.

title: Gravitational force expression
description: Essential: The student must provide the correct formula for the gravitational force, F = 4π²mr / T².

title: Centripetal force reasoning
description: Important: The student must identify that the gravitational force provides the centripetal force for circular motion.

title: Period and velocity relation
description: Important: The student must correctly relate the orbital period T to the circumference and speed for uniform circular motion.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The student's final expressions should have dimensionally consistent units (e.g., length/time for velocity).

title: Incorrect centripetal formula
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect centripetal force formula (e.g., mv²/r instead of mω²r) without proper substitution for ω.

title: Missing force identification
description: Pitfall: Stating the centripetal force formula without explicitly identifying it as the gravitational force.
